 Persebaya vs Western Australia Tonight: Schedule, Live Broadcast, and the Green Force's Revival Mission
 Persebaya Surabaya faces the Western Australia Football Team in an international friendly match held at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium (GBT).
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Niken Pramudya 
 November 15, 2026 at 9:08 PM WITA ·
 5 min read
 Archive of the Persebaya Surabaya match against the Football West All Star in Perth, Western Australia, July 9, 2025. Photo: Persebaya Surabaya. 
 SURABAYA, Aktualita.co -   Persebaya Surabaya faces the Western Australia Football Team in an international friendly match held at Gelora Bung Tomo (GBT) Stadium, Surabaya, on Sunday (11/15/2026) evening. 
 The duel between Persebaya and Western Australia serves as an important opportunity for the Bajul Ijo squad to improve their performance after failing to secure a win in their last three domestic competition matches.

 The match, titled International Friendly Game , is scheduled to start at 19:30 WIB and can be watched via live broadcast on Indosiar as well as the Vidio live streaming service. 
 Although it is only a friendly match, it holds significant meaning for Persebaya coach Bernardo Tavares. The Portuguese tactician wants to utilize the November 2026 FIFA Matchday break to evaluate squad depth while providing opportunities for young players. 
 On the other hand, Western Australia arrives with a selection of players from the National Premier Leagues Western Australia competition. The presence of former Persebaya player Aryn Williams also serves as a special attraction for the home supporters. 
 Persebaya Aims to Rise After Three Winless Matches 
 Persebaya enters this international match with a significant amount of homework. 
 In the previous three matches, the team nicknamed the Green Force has not managed to secure a victory. Persebaya first drew 1-1 against Persijap Jepara before losing 2-3 to Kendal Tornado FC in the 2026/2027 I.League Cup. 
 The unsatisfactory results continued when Persebaya fell 0-1 to Persija Jakarta in a Super League match. 
 This string of results has led Tavares to focus on the players' mental state and confidence. 
 The Persebaya coach hopes the match against Western Australia will be a momentum to restore playing spirit while improving coordination between lines. 
 In a press conference on Saturday (11/14/2026), Tavares emphasized that every player must take advantage of the opportunity to appear to prove their quality. 
 "This match is a good opportunity for all players to show their abilities." 
 — Bernardo Tavares, Persebaya Surabaya coach. 
 Tavares does not only judge players based on the final result of the match. He also wants to see character, responsibility, and the players' ability to execute instructions on the field. 
 Bernardo Tavares Opens Opportunities for Young Players to Appear 
 The Persebaya vs Western Australia match is also an opportunity for players who have not received many minutes of play throughout the 2026/2027 season. 
 A number of young players have the chance to show their readiness to compete for a spot in the main lineup. 
 In addition to young players, Tavares is considering playing time for those who have just recovered from injuries. 
 However, the decision regarding their involvement still depends on their fitness condition and medical team recommendations. 
 One name attracting attention is Matheus Lagoa. The new Persebaya player has a chance to get playing time if declared medically fit. 
 For the coaching staff, a friendly match against an international opponent provides additional insight into the players' abilities when facing pressure and different playing styles. 
 This evaluation is expected to help Persebaya determine the best composition when returning to competitive matches. 
 Western Australia Brings 18 Players, Including Aryn Williams 
 The Western Australia Football Team is not an A-League Australia club, but a select team formed by Football West, the football organization of the state of Western Australia. 
 The team, coached by Ivan Zuvela, arrived in Surabaya with 18 players from various clubs. 
 Some names in the traveling party include Aryn Williams, Josh Risdon, Jack Clisby, Mitch Oxborrow, Kade Fearnall, and Charlie Chechlacz. 
 Chechlacz is one player to watch after winning the National Premier Leagues Western Australia player of the year award in 2026. 
 Meanwhile, Aryn Williams is the most recognizable figure for Persebaya supporters. 
 The player who once strengthened Bajul Ijo during the 2019–2020 period returns to Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium, this time as part of the opposing team. 
 "Of course, it's nice to be back in Surabaya and play against Persebaya." 
 — Aryn Williams, Western Australia Football Team player. 
 Williams' presence brings a sense of reunion with the Bonek and Bonita who once witnessed his performance when he played for Persebaya. 
 Coach Ivan Zuvela himself views the match against Persebaya as a major test for his team, especially since they have to play in front of the home supporters. 
 Persebaya Once Defeated Western Australia 2-0 
 The meeting between the two teams in November 2026 is a continuation of the football cooperation between Persebaya and Football West. 
 The partnership has been established since 2018 and has been realized through a number of exchange activities and friendly matches. 
 On July 9, 2025, Persebaya played a trial match against the Football West All Star at the Sam Kerr Football Centre, Perth, Western Australia. 
 In that match, Persebaya managed to secure a 2-0 victory. 
 Francisco Rivera opened the scoring for the Green Force in the 61st minute after utilizing a combined attack from Bruno Moreira and Gali Freitas. 
 The second goal was then scored by Rizky Dwi through a powerful shot from outside the penalty box near the end of the match. 
 Now, it is Western Australia's turn to make a return visit to Surabaya. 
 The match at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium also serves as part of an effort to strengthen sports relations between East Java and Western Australia. 
 Persebaya vs Western Australia Match Also for Charity 
 Not only serving as an international friendly, this match also carries a social mission. 
 Persebaya has packaged the meeting with Western Australia as a Charity Game . 
 The club stated that proceeds from ticket sales for the match will be donated to orphanages in East Java. 
 This agenda received a positive response from Bernardo Tavares because it is considered to provide benefits beyond sports interests. 
 This activity shows that football matches can be a means to build solidarity while strengthening relationships between communities. 
 Schedule and Live Broadcast of Persebaya vs Western Australia 
 For supporters who want to follow the Persebaya vs Western Australia match, here is the schedule information announced: 
 Match: Persebaya Surabaya vs Western Australia Football Team 
 Competition: International Friendly Game 2026 
 Date: Sunday, November 15, 2026 
 Kickoff: 19:30 WIB 
 Stadium: Gelora Bung Tomo, Surabaya 
 Live broadcast: Indosiar 
 Live streaming: Vidio 
 In addition to national television broadcasts and streaming services, Football West also announced the broadcast of the match through its official YouTube channel. 
 For Persebaya, this match is not solely about chasing a win. Evaluation of young players, improvement of team cooperation, and restoration of confidence are the main agendas ahead of the resumption of the domestic competition. 
 The result of the match and the goalscorers for Persebaya vs Western Australia on November 15, 2026, still require confirmation from the official match report.
